_why: Submitted user content keeps its authored structure and full copy payload while visually long text has a measured disclosure.

collapse.resize: remeasure without resetting explicit expansion for identical text
collapse.focus: partially visible links remain active; other controls must be fully visible
collapse.print: show full body, hide toggle, restore previous state afterward

actions.files: Retain stored paths and the transcript owner; resolve relative paths against that owner's directory before previewing.
actions.quotes: Open the full retained selection in a read-only text reader with copy and focus restoration.
actions.pastedText: Open the stored file, or the full retained legacy text when there is no stored path.

references.file: Preview the exact referenced file with its transcript owner.
references.folder: Reveal the exact folder through the owning workspace capability.
references.skill: Read the exact retained definition path when the host catalog advertises its preview capability; other skill identities remain readable.
references.plugin: Show read-only metadata and contributions for the exact installed plugin ID.
references.other: Keep readable identity without inventing unsupported destinations.

actions.failures: Surface unavailable resources without changing the draft or creating a conversation.

copy.scope: full authored text bubble, excluding sibling attachment cards and action controls
copy.eligibility: A user row exposes Copy only when its authored body has non-whitespace content; attachment-only rows retain their other applicable actions.
copy.collapsed: copy full text without changing expansion
copy.identity: preserve semantic inline token data in HTML
copy.literal: Markdown-looking prose stays literal when pasted back
copy.plainIdentity: Typed resource links keep their label and address; native file mentions copy the full path.
copy.legacy: Without an authored document snapshot, copy the full stored plain body and exclude sibling attachment cards.
